title: Anabelian Geometry in Families
summary: Anabelian geometry as an attempt to describe geometry in terms of étale topological data has addressed so far mainly categories of varieties over a field. In this paper we work over a normal base scheme $S$ of finite type over a sub-$p$-adic field and show that families of hyperbolic curves over $S$ are anabelian among smooth $S$-schemes with respect to dominant morphisms.
